subject: Supplier portal account stuck in activation loop - Acme Supplies
messages:
From: Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@acme-supplies.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding - account activation keeps failing

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. I followed the Coupa invitation link and completed the registration, but the portal keeps returning me to the initial 'Verify email' screen after I click the confirmation link. I've attached a screenshot of the page and the browser console shows a 500 from coupa-auth.

Also attached is our completed W9 and a copy of our ACH details (redacted). Can you check whether the invite went through on your side or if there's an account conflict?

Attachments: W9_AcmeSupplies.pdf (application/pdf), coupa-invite-error-screenshot.png (image/png)

Thanks,
Eleanor
Vendor Operations
Acme Supplies, Inc.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
To: Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com, sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding - account activation keeps failing

Hi Eleanor — thanks for the quick note and attachments.

I'm looping in Laura (Procurement) and Sean (Partner Ops) to check the Coupa invite and confirm there isn't an existing duplicate account for Acme Supplies. Initial checks on my side show an invite was sent from HubSpot (HS-93217) yesterday at 15:22 UTC to procure-admin@acme-supplies.com.

Immediate asks:
- Laura/Sean: can you confirm whether the invite is accepted in the Coupa portal and whether there are any pending admin approvals on your tenant?
- Eleanor: can you confirm the email you used to register (procure-admin@acme-supplies.com?) and whether you tried from a different browser/incognito?

I'll stay on this thread until it's resolved. If needed we can create a fresh invite and escalate to Coupa support.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>, Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com, marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-04-19T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding - account activation keeps failing

On 18 Apr 2027, Vanessa Ortiz wrote:
> Immediate asks:
> - Laura/Sean: can you confirm whether the invite is accepted in the Coupa portal and whether there are any pending admin approvals on your tenant?

Thanks, Vanessa. I pulled the invite record. The first invite shows status: "Accepted" but there are two accounts tied to Acme's TAX ID (one with a prior vendor alias). That can create an activation loop where the system can't reconcile the account.

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Sean, can Partner Ops merge the duplicate tenant records or temporarily suspend the older alias? I can approve a new invite once that's done.
2) Eleanor — please re-upload the W9 to the attached bank-template and resend the ACH file (we only need last 4 digits masked for validation).
3) Marcus — can you run a quick Coupa audit (audit log link below) to confirm the 500 error in the auth service around 2027-04-18T08:14:00-07:00?

If we can't merge quickly, I'll issue a one-time manual account activation so they can receive POs while we reconcile.

Audit link: https://internal.redwood.com/coupa/audit/ACCT-9932

Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com <sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>, Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-04-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding - account activation keeps failing

On 19 Apr 2027, laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com wrote:
> If we can't merge quickly, I'll issue a one-time manual account activation so they can receive POs while we reconcile.

Quick update — Marcus confirmed the 500 error was a transient auth spike tied to a stale callback on our SSO connector; it has been patched by infra at 09:12 UTC this morning. I merged the duplicate vendor alias and manually activated Acme Supplies' Coupa account (temp vendor ID: RWI-78421).

Eleanor — you should have a new invite in your inbox (subject: "Redwood - Supplier Portal Access"). Once you accept, please confirm and we'll issue a test PO to validate payment flows.

Attachments: banking_details_template.xlsx (for final ACH), DocuSign link for banking validation will follow.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Sean Gallagher
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
